description: Source code for a plugin managing WLD (Wireless Local Device) lifecycle, configuration, and modules, including initialization, startup, and shutdown routines.

methods.name: s_sendLifecycleEvent
methods.description: Triggers a lifecycle event callback with the specified change.

methods.name: s_addGenRadiosAndLoadConf
methods.description: Adds radios via wifiGen and loads configuration persistence.

methods.name: _app_start
methods.description: Handles application start event, initializes data model, and triggers lifecycle event.

methods.name: s_initPluginConf
methods.description: Initializes plugin configuration by ensuring config file and directory exist.

methods.name: s_getModDir
methods.description: Retrieves the module directory path from configuration or constructs it from plugin path.

methods.name: _wld_main
methods.description: Main entry point for plugin, handling start and stop reasons, initializing or deinitializing components.
